name: Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductors, aerospace, automobile, mobility, and industrial electrical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers clean transport systems, including 300mm FOUP load port, 300/200MM auto switch load port, 200MM SMIF load port, EFEM, panel FOUP load port, and tape frame FOUP load port; testing systems, such as high-speed dynamometer and power train testers; vibrating equipment, including vibrating conveyor, vibrating drier and cooler, and small vibrating equipment; parts feeders, such as dual-motion parts feeder, high speed parts feeder, and vibrating transporting table; and lifting magnets.
